why: RJ-H36, pending PH-5 (halo/placed-images): places a 200 x 100 two-colour PNG logo (red left half, blue right half) into a 400 x 400 composition over a black solid by command and exports frame 0 as a PNG. Until PH-5 the render draws a solid's colour, not its picture, and place.image is registered at PH-6, so platforms is [] and the harness skips the job on both. The trap: the viewer shows the logo but the render draws the solid's colour, or stretches the logo to the composition. The assertion: centred at its own size, (110, 200) is red and (290, 200) blue within 2/255, and (98, 200) and (200, 148), just outside it, are the black background (HaloPlaceRenderTests.logoPixels). The turn-on sets platforms to linux and macos.
